constraints.message: Quantity must sit between price_units minimum and maximum and be a multiple of step.
Line net must reach minimum_billing. Lift the quantity or the line cost to meet it.
Where minimum billing lifted the line, show rate = net / qty so the client sheet multiplies out. Note that minimum billing was applied.
The transit master carries no city or state column. State is derived from the product name and must be desk-checked.
constraints.source: products has no location columns, radio and cinema have a Location sheet

do: State the panel specification exactly as the master names it.
dont: Never imply a vehicle runs a fixed route unless the master names one.
